speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin my evaluation, have you noticed any changes in your urine color, such as it becoming dark like tea or cola, or any changes in your stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) or Cholestatic Hepatitis.

REQUEST IMAGES: Liver Ultrasound
REQUEST TEST: AMA (Antimitochondrial Antibody), Anti-LKM1, Anti-SLA, IgM levels, and Fractional Bile Acids.

Given your history of ulcerative colitis, sexual activity with multiple partners, and symptoms of cholestasis (fatigue, itching, jaundice risk), we must rule out autoimmune overlap, viral hepatitis, or drug-induced liver injury immediately. Have you noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin recently?
